text: FAA guidance describes starting emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link and attempting to reestablish the control link if possible, with guidance to land, hover, or use a return-to-home sequence if VLOS cannot be regained. The DJI Matrice 30T manual states RTH can be triggered actively by the user, on low battery, or when the control signal is lost, and that the aircraft will automatically land at the Home Point if conditions are normal. The incident reports (unverified) describe lost-link events with RTH on back-to-back hops, RTH at programmed altitude without issue, and RTH initiation without response.
